conflicts.where: Lessons 5 and 12 vs Lesson 3 (layer forces and Lesson 7 classification)
conflicts.problem: Lesson 7 and Lesson 8 classify graphite as a 'giant covalent' structure, but Lesson 6 says graphite has 'partial metallic character' and Lesson 5 says its layers are held by Van der Waals forces. Lesson 9 says graphite's delocalised electron moves 'between layers' while Lessons 4, 6, 12 say it is delocalised 'within each layer/across the layer'. The location of the delocalised electrons is inconsistent across lessons.

conflicts.where: Lesson 1 vs Lessons 9, 10, 13 (timing and number of lessons)
conflicts.problem: Lesson 1 says the class will spend 'the next 26 lessons' solving the mystery, but the sequence has only 13 lessons, and Lesson 13 says 'thirteen lessons'. Lessons are also given inconsistent durations (80-minute in Lessons 3, 5 and 10 vs 40-minute in Lessons 9 and 13 and 55 minutes of building in Lesson 12).

Lesson 10 says SiO2's giant covalent network gives 'transparency', which was never investigated and sits oddly with the Lesson 8 data. The lessons also describe SiO2 as having 'extreme hardness' in Lesson 12 without any test.
